problem: Repeated shipping postcode-zone location loads across distinct destination lookups
change_summary: Caches the all-postcode shipping zone location list under the existing shipping_zones cache prefix and group.
Reuses the cached postcode list across distinct get_zone_id_from_package() destination lookups.
Relies on existing shipping zone create/update/delete invalidation through WC_Cache_Helper::invalidate_cache_group( 'shipping_zones' ).

direct_probe.precondition: wp_cache_flush() and WC_Cache_Helper::invalidate_cache_group( 'shipping_zones' ) before each iteration

default_cart_sanity_check.scenario: Store API cart/update-customer with one shippable taxable product and US/CA/94105 destination
default_cart_sanity_check.interpretation: Default one-package cart requests still perform one postcode-location load per request. PR #32 targets repeated distinct destination lookups inside the same request or persistent cache window, not the already measured one-package cart baseline.

verification: npx pnpm@10.33.0 --filter @woocommerce/plugin-woocommerce test:php:env -- --filter WC_Shipping_Zone_Data_Store_CPT_Test: OK (7 tests, 13 assertions)
